Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was
struck while executing a left turn. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent
with the nature and force of the impact. Presenting complaints were neck pain,
restricted cervical range of motion, and headaches consistent with cervical strain and
whiplash-associated disorder. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings
clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. There is no known prior injury or treatment
involving the same body region.
Over the course of care, the patient completed 29 visits consisting of manual therapy,
therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical
clinical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms and range of motion
improved. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no
duplicate or repeated billing observed.
At the time of discharge, the patient was improving and was instructed to continue a
home exercise program. Follow-up was recommended on an as-needed basis should symptoms
recur.
